name: test_custom_rebuttal_verifies_requested_values_before_submit
description:
Objective: Custom rebuttal verifies requested values before submit.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/offers/test_broker_offer_review_page.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Invoke `page.set_content` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
5. Invoke `BrokerOfferReviewPage.submit_custom_rebuttal` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
6. Evaluate the encoded observable UI/service checks: `to_have_value`, `to_be_visible`.
7. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Custom rebuttal verifies requested values before submit.
2. The encoded UI/service checks pass: To have value, To be visible.
3. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
